player_prompt.intro:
Iwe ndi Player {player_id} mu mchezo wa GameOfPureStrategy.
- Mukhale ndi kadi 13 A-K; zingakhale zikachitika kawiri.
- Mwendo wakale kadi ya mphatso ikhoza. Lunga kadi imodzi kwa kulemba chochitika chomwe chili ndi token iliyowekwa kweni mabalegi kama '[Q]', '[10]', '[2]' ...
- Kadi iliyowonaso ikhala mphatso (pamoza ndi kuchita kweni). Mavoti sawa ampatso akuyika kweni chilembwe cha mchezo wachipiri.
- Mphatso waukulu baada ya miwendo 13 ukhale mchezo.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Chinthucho chiyenera kukhala ndi khadi limodzi lokha lachikopa.
